data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to get real-time device location across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to request the current location and listen to continuous location updates. Supports background mode on Android and iOS and works on web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: you need raw GPS/Network location on multiple platforms
you want background location tracking while the app is alive
you prefer a lightweight solution without map UI
avoid_when: you need built‑in map widgets or advanced geofencing
you require location after the app is terminated
strengths: stream of location changes via onLocationChanged
weaknesses: no map UI or geofencing features
background tracking stops when app is killed
data.setup_notes: Add location permissions to AndroidManifest (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, optional ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION). Add NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription / NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription and UIBackgroundModes=location to iOS Info.plist. Enable App Sandbox > Location on macOS. No extra steps for web, Windows, Linux.
